name: NAVER second data center proposed Daegu Technopolis site
notes: Daegu submitted Dalseong-gun Technopolis research-facility land for NAVER's second data center bid in 2019; NAVER ultimately opened its second IDC as GAK Sejong, so the Daegu/Dalseong proposal is treated as unsuccessful rather than an active project.

name: LG U+ Daegu Center
notes: LG U+ official IDC page lists the Daegu center at 295-1 Dongin 1-ga / 186 Dongdeok-ro, Jung-gu, Daegu, with 20,000 kW power and Tier-3-class availability.

name: KT-IDC Daegu center at KT Daegu headquarters
notes: ETNews reported Korea Telecom opened a roughly 500-pyeong KT-IDC in the Daegu headquarters building in Bongdeok-dong, Nam-gu in January 2001; current operating status was not confirmed in this pass.

name: SK C&C AI Data Center at Suseong Alpha City
developer: SK C&C; SK REITs Management; Atto Research
notes: Daegu investment page reports a Dec. 4, 2023 investment/cooperation agreement for an AI data center in Suseong Alpha City; private investment about KRW 800 billion, 40 MW receiving capacity, 9,917 sq m site and 29,700 sq m gross floor area.

name: Pyeongchon-dong Data Center
developer: KR Logis Daejeon No.3 PFV; Gangjin Industrial Development; K-REITs Investment Management
notes: Daedeok-gu official notice says the district signed an MOU on Sept. 30, 2024 with KR Logis Daejeon No.3 PFV and partners to support construction of a data center in Pyeongchon-dong.
